name: BrickerP.github.io
description: First-person generative Beijing night drive and personal portfolio on GitHub Pages.

paragraphs: A seamless first-person night drive through an imagined Beijing. The camera travels at driver-eye height through twelve authored passages in Second-Ring relative order — Tiananmen on the central axis, the palace moat, Shichahai with the white dagoba, Deshengmen, the Second-Ring city threshold, Bell & Drum Towers, Nanluo/Wudaoying, Yonghegong, a CBD/finance skyline, the Temple of Heaven, Qianmen's Dashilar with hutong density, and an overpass return — then arrives back at the same frame every forty-eight seconds.

Artistic composition, not for navigation. This is not a driving aid, road simulation or reconstruction of real streets. The road and city are procedurally authored for the artwork; no commercial tiles, scraped coordinates, live APIs or third-party location services are used.
The runtime derives the full scene from one normalized phase:
features: Stack: Vite · TypeScript · Three.js · plain CSS
View: one first-person drive, with no cockpit or alternate camera mode
Loop: deterministic 48-second closed journey across twelve Beijing passages
Recording: one complete loop exported as WebM when the browser supports it
